title: Loop Station
prompt: Turn Spotify into a loop station with eight pads, saved IN and OUT points, and real playback loops.
css:
.mls-launch{background:#1ed760!important;color:#08150c!important;border:0!important;border-radius:999px!important;padding:5px 13px!important;font-size:11px!important;font-weight:700!important;cursor:pointer!important;position:absolute;left:calc(50% + 150px);bottom:58px;white-space:nowrap;z-index:5}
.mls-panel{position:fixed;z-index:900;left:50%;top:48%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);width:min(980px,90vw);max-height:80vh;overflow:auto;padding:28px;background:#151515;color:#fff;border:1px solid #444;border-radius:16px;box-shadow:0 30px 100px #000b;font:14px/1.4 -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,sans-serif}.mls-panel[hidden]{display:none!important}.mls-panel *{box-sizing:border-box}.mls-panel button{cursor:pointer;background:#292929;color:#fff;border:1px solid #555;border-radius:999px;padding:9px 15px;font:600 12px/1.2 inherit}.mls-head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-start;gap:20px}.mls-eyebrow{font-size:10px;color:#1ed760;letter-spacing:2px}.mls-head h2{font-size:34px;font-weight:750;letter-spacing:-1px;line-height:1.2;margin:6px 0}.mls-track{color:#aaa;font-size:15px;margin:0}.mls-readout{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;margin:22px 0 10px}.mls-clock{font:500 20px/1.4 ui-monospace,monospace}.mls-status{color:#1ed760;font-size:12px}.mls-timeline{height:38px;position:relative;background:repeating-linear-gradient(90deg,#292929 0 3px,#202020 3px 12px);border-radius:6px;margin-bottom:18px;overflow:hidden}.mls-region{position:absolute;top:0;bottom:0;background:#1ed76066;border-left:2px solid #1ed760;border-right:2px solid #1ed760}.mls-playhead{position:absolute;top:0;bottom:0;border-left:2px solid #fff;z-index:2}.mls-controls{display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:22px}.mls-controls label{font-size:10px;color:#aaa;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;letter-spacing:1px}.mls-controls input{background:#242424;color:white;border:1px solid #555;border-radius:6px;padding:9px;font-size:12px;width:65px}.mls-controls input[type=text]{width:150px}.mls-controls .mls-save{background:#1ed760;color:#071c0e;border-color:#1ed760}.mls-pads{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));gap:12px}.mls-panel .mls-pad{min-height:115px;border-radius:10px;border:1px solid #424242;background:#222;text-align:left;padding:16px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px;transition:background .12s,border-color .12s}.mls-pad-number{font:500 13px/1 ui-monospace,monospace;color:#777}.mls-pad strong{font-size:16px;font-weight:600;color:#888}.mls-pad small{font-size:11px;font-weight:400;color:#777}.mls-panel .mls-pad.has-loop{background:#173323;border-color:#367d4b}.mls-pad.has-loop strong{color:white}.mls-pad.has-loop small,.mls-pad.has-loop .mls-pad-number{color:#9ecbaa}.mls-panel .mls-pad.is-active{background:#1ed760;border-color:#78ff9d;box-shadow:0 0 24px #1ed76033}.mls-pad.is-active strong,.mls-pad.is-active small,.mls-pad.is-active .mls-pad-number{color:#06200e}.mls-help{margin:18px 0 0;color:#888;font-size:11px}@media(max-width:700px){.mls-pads{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}.mls-panel{padding:18px}.mls-head h2{font-size:26px}}
